edges.reason: Constructor writes clusterControllerAddress.
Constructor writes treasuryAddress.
Constructor loads dhvTokenInstance from the controller.
Constructor assigns underlyings array.
Constructor assigns underlyingsShares array.
Admin-only setter writes cooldownPeriod.
onlyAdmin verifies msg.sender holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
pause is restricted to the admin role checked against msg.sender.
unpause is restricted to the admin role checked against msg.sender.
controllerChange requires msg.sender to equal clusterControllerAddress.
controllerChange overwrites clusterControllerAddress.
block.timestamp is written into cooldownTimestamps (timestamp dependency).
assemble sets cooldownTimestamps[msg.sender] = block.timestamp + cooldownPeriod.
mintFor sets cooldownTimestamps[_account] from block.timestamp.
transfer is gated by checkCooldownPeriod reading cooldownTimestamps.
transferFrom is gated by checkCooldownPeriod reading cooldownTimestamps.
assemble reads caller balance and mints cluster tokens to msg.sender.
disassemble pulls tokens from and burns for msg.sender.
onlyMinter checks the msg.sender role in mint.
onlyMinter checks the msg.sender role in mintFor.
onlyMinter checks the msg.sender role in burn.
onlyFarmer checks the msg.sender role in withdrawToAccumulation.
onlyFarmer checks the msg.sender role in refundFromAccumulation.
onlyDelegate checks the msg.sender role in optimizeProportion.
assemble calls _payInEth to refund dust ETH.
assemble calls _coverCommission.
assemble calls _swapEthToUnderlyings.
_payInEth performs a raw value call to msg.sender.
msg.sender is the recipient of the raw ETH transfer in _payInEth.
State changes in assemble occur around the ETH payout to msg.sender.
msg.sender can reenter disassemble while receiving ETH from _payInEth.
_coverCommission sends ETH to treasury using a raw call.
Treasury raw value call happens inside assemble.
Treasury raw value call happens inside disassemble.
_swapEthToUnderlyings performs treasury and adapter value calls.
External adapter/treasury value calls are made during assemble.
disassemble calls _payInEth to send ETH back to msg.sender.
disassemble calls _coverCommission for the redeem commission.
disassemble calls _swapUnderlyingsToEth.
_swapUnderlyingsToEth approves and calls the external adapter.
External adapter call is executed inside disassemble before the burn settles.
refundFromAccumulation performs unchecked style decrements on lock values.
Decrements of clusterLock/clusterTokenLock can underflow.
optimizeProportion subtracts current from new amounts and locks.
withdrawToAccumulation increments clusterLock[tkn].
refundFromAccumulation decrements clusterLock[tkn].
withdrawToAccumulation adds _clusterAmount to clusterTokenLock.
refundFromAccumulation subtracts _clusterAmount from clusterTokenLock.
optimizeProportion rewrites clusterLock[tkn] with the new lock.
getUnderlyingsAmountsFromClusterAmount reads locked balances via getUnderlyingBalance.
getUnderlyingBalance adds clusterLock[_underlying] to the token balance.
coverDhvWithEth parameter is consumed by assemble.
_clusterAmount parameter is consumed by disassemble.
recipient parameter is consumed by transfer.
sender parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
_account parameter is consumed by mintFor.
_tokens parameter is consumed by withdrawToAccumulation.
_amounts parameter is consumed by withdrawToAccumulation.
updatedShares parameter is consumed by optimizeProportion.
_underlying parameter is consumed by getUnderlyingBalance.
_cooldownPeriod parameter is consumed by setCooldownPeriod.
_controller parameter is consumed by controllerChange.
ethAmount local is computed and used inside assemble.
balanceBefore local is captured inside assemble.
balanceAfter local is captured inside assemble.
denominator local is produced by _swapEthToUnderlyings and used in assemble.
clusterAmount local is minted in assemble.
underlyingAmounts local is used inside disassemble.
ethEstimated local is used inside disassemble.
currentAllowance local is read in transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: The boolean parameter only selects the commission branch of assemble.
The redemption amount parameter is only meaningful for disassemble.
The recipient parameter is only consumed by the transfer override.
The sender parameter is only consumed by the transferFrom override.
The destination account parameter is only used by mintFor.
The token list parameter is only used by withdrawToAccumulation.
The amount list parameter is only used by withdrawToAccumulation.
The new share weights parameter is only used by optimizeProportion.
The underlying address parameter is only used by getUnderlyingBalance.
The new cooldown value parameter is only used by setCooldownPeriod.
The new controller address parameter is only used by controllerChange.
